summary.text: Robb Greene is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 47, assumed office on November 9, 2022, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Michael Potter (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Robb Greene lives in Shelby County, Indiana, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Indiana University-Purdue University Indianapolis.
His career experience includes working as a logistics consultant, a tech entrepreneur, and the chief operating officer of ClusterTruck.
Greene succeeded John Young (R) in District 47.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Agriculture and Rural Development Committee and a member of the Government and Regulatory Reform and Ways and Means committees.
